rationale:
`assets/skills/habeas-requirements/SKILL.md` is a bundled skill with front matter, so it is a site of `requirements.cli.skill_conventions.references`. The requirement lets a skill put specialized material in linked files. It requires each such link to say when to read the file.

The skill has no Markdown links. It points to two other files in code spans, and each pointer says when to read the file:
- `references/review-prompt.md` appears in workflow step 3 (Review). It says to tell each review subagent to read it, so the trigger is starting a group review. The step also says what to do without subagents: review each group yourself against the prompt.
- The habeas-evidence skill's `references/fixme.md` appears at the end of "Choosing references". It is named for when you "defer a requirement gap the user agrees to" using `{fixme}`.

The other pointers are to whole skills (the habeas skill's `SKILL.md`, habeas-evidence, habeas-refactor). They are not specialized reference files, and they already come with a situation, for example "Not for moving code ... use habeas-refactor".

No violation matches were listed. The site meets the obligation, so there is no gap.
